title: Postcard Wave
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -6 dB gain before AAC encoding; stream-only limiter at 0.35 linear amplitude with no makeup gain. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: Original all-ages melodic-house instrumental for a beginner-friendly one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 124 BPM in 4/4 for 128 seconds. Keep a FULLY AUDIBLE quantized house drum machine at final level from the FIRST SECOND to the final bar: short strong kick on EVERY quarter beat, dry clear clap on beats two and four, crisp closed eighth-note hats, and one separate short midrange wooden-key or pluck attack on EVERY beat, including the first 16 seconds and the entire middle. No fade-in, ambient intro, sparse pad-only breakdown, drum dropout, half-time passage, swing, tempo drift or long smeared reverb hiding attacks. Signature hook: three warm wooden-key notes step downward in a simple contour, pause for one eighth-note, then a single higher glass chime answers from the opposite stereo side; make the answer a distinct timbre and rhythmic position. Support with round offbeat bass and restrained soft major-seventh chord fragments BEHIND the beat markers. At the midpoint keep the exact uninterrupted drum grid, start with the high chime answer, reverse the wooden-key contour and change bass roots; the final quarter adds a short second chime reply and resolves the motifs in a new cadence instead of copying the first minute. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, warm and easy to follow, with controlled highs and no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Postcard Wave, an all-ages melodic-house rhythm-game track. High-contrast original editorial comic-print collage on near-black ink, warm-ivory paper, coral red and electric cyan. Main motif: ONE oversized blank warm-ivory POSTCARD-shaped rectangle tilted upward, its near corner folded back to reveal a broad cyan zigzag sound wave emerging from underneath; exactly three small separate coral paper bars sit above the card like three warm notes. The postcard must read as a simple flat cut-paper rectangle, not an envelope, screen or existing postal brand. Crisp tactile edges, sparse halftone, playful diagonal motion and quiet dark lower fifth for a local title overlay. At 100px the rectangle, cyan wave and three bars stay distinct. No stamp, address, writing, letters, numbers, logos, people, city, landscape, photograph, watermark or copied game art.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Postcard Wave square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve ONE large blank warm-ivory tilted postcard rectangle with its near corner folded back, the broad electric-cyan zigzag wave emerging from underneath and exactly three separate small coral bars above it, in near-black comic-print ink and sparse halftone. Recompose the paper motif on the RIGHT two-thirds, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Postcard Wave' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Build a real wide composition rather than stretching the square. No other text, letters, numbers, stamp, address, screen, people, landscape, photograph, logos, watermark or copied game art.
